# smart-trust-document-kinds

How this IG realises the document kinds of the layers it needs: today `dak.coverage.smart-trust.json`, the DAK view of `fhir-artifact-index/`, which places each artefact in one of the ten DAK components by its FHIR resource type and lists what no rule places. GENERATED by the DAK layer's `gen-document-kinds.ts` (`bun run cat smart-base:document-kinds`, gated by `smart-base:document-kinds:check`) into this directory, because the report is about this IG: it lived beside the DAK kind in the layer below until wrong-direction move M13 (folio-assistant#2598), where it was a lower layer holding a file about a higher one. Declared with its file in one commit, per bean `dh4f`.

Part of [WHO SMART Trust](../README.md) 0.1.0, declared as `smart-trust-document-kinds`, holding `document-kinds`.
